task_instruction: 示例（非正式测试案例）：围绕「图神经网络用于单步逆合成预测的准确率水平、低数据泛化与评测口径可比性」跑一条 PRISMA 式系统综述流程：检索式 → 题录级筛选 → 全文级合格性 → 质量评价 → 证据矩阵与结论 → 四阶段计数与排除理由表。

output_contract.search_strategy: 检索要素块、布尔检索式、数据库/字段/时间/语言限制与每库题录数
output_contract.screening_log: 两轮（题录级/全文级）逐条筛选结论、criterion_id 与理由码
output_contract.prisma_flow: 识别/筛选/合格/纳入四阶段计数 + 各阶段排除理由聚合 + 计数一致性校验
output_contract.quality_appraisal: 纳入研究逐维度质量判定（依据位置）、总分与等级、等级对结论的影响
output_contract.evidence_matrix: 证据矩阵：record_id + span（字段+整句）+ 主题 + sha256，支撑综合结论
output_contract.synthesis: 综合结论：逐条挂 evidence_id、支持强度、冲突并列、边界说明
output_contract.evidence_map: 协议版本、检索块、条款、理由码、质量量表、计数一致性、产物自检
output_contract.状态说明: 完成/部分完成、纳入集为空、主题无证据、质量偏低、冲突、检索时间未记录等不确定性

research_question: 图神经网络用于单步逆合成预测时，报告的 top-1 准确率水平如何，低数据条件下的泛化表现如何，不同研究的评测口径是否可比？

protocol.primary_reason_note: 同一记录同一阶段命中多条排除条款时，主因取本表最先命中者；其余命中记入 secondary_hits，不重复计数。

records.title: Retrosynthesis Prediction with Graph Neural Networks and Message Passing
records.abstract: We present a graph neural network with a learned reaction centre representation for single-step retrosynthesis and report 52.3% top-1 accuracy on USPTO-50k with three dataset splits.
records.text: We describe the message passing encoder and training schedule. Limitation: single dataset only, no cross-dataset evaluation.
records.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

records.title: Retrosynthesis Prediction with Graph Neural Networks and Message Passing
records.abstract: Preprint version of the same graph neural network retrosynthesis study.

records.title: Template-free retrosynthesis via graph attention
records.abstract: A template-free model reports 48.1% top-1 accuracy on USPTO-50k and compares against template baselines; we evaluate a single split only.
records.text: Training uses graph attention encoders. Limitation: no cross-split evaluation, possible leakage cannot be excluded.

records.title: Low-data retrosynthesis: how much training data do we need
records.abstract: Under low data conditions (under 500 training reactions) top-1 accuracy drops by 12 percentage points and the learned representation generalizes poorly across reaction classes.
records.text: We evaluate on three dataset splits and report the accuracy decay curve. Limitation: only one model family tested.

records.title: Benchmarking graph neural networks for reaction yield prediction
records.abstract: A benchmark with three dataset splits shows that reported top-1 accuracy differences are largely explained by split choice rather than architecture, which limits comparability.

records.title: Re-examining single-step retrosynthesis benchmarks
records.abstract: We reproduce the message passing model on USPTO-50k and obtain 49.0% top-1 accuracy instead of 52.3%, indicating evaluation leakage between splits.
records.text: Training code and split definitions are released. Limitation: only two datasets re-examined.

records.title: Multi-step route planning with learned heuristics
records.abstract: Multi-step route planning is evaluated by route success rate rather than top-1 accuracy, so single-step numbers are not directly comparable.

records.title: Catalytic C-H activation with earth-abundant metals
records.abstract: An experimental study on catalytic C-H activation with no computational retrosynthesis modelling and no accuracy metric.
